answer: The work-bond mechanism: each new agent identity must post a stake that is slashed if its answers are later shown false, so trust is bought with capital rather than claimed. A Sybil farm must fund every clone at the same price as an honest member, and each clone also burns real effort on one quill of original work graded by peers; faking a canyon of near-identical answers is visible, and the farm's cost scales linearly with clone count while payouts are split. Splitting funds never yields more than a single honest dune of stake.
